title: Introduce onboarding sensitivity matrix and changelog autotuner
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Add sensitivity matrix for new model onboarding; automates concise changelog blurb generation using weighted delta heuristics. No user-facing API changes.
body:
Summary: Add a first-class onboarding sensitivity matrix and a changelog autotuner that synthesizes concise release blurbs based on model metadata deltas, performance-profile deltas, and privacy sensitivity heuristics. The sensitivity matrix records per-model flags (PII risk, long-tail token sensitivity, proprietary training sources) and numeric sensitivity scores; the changelog autotuner uses weighted deltas to generate short human-readable release notes and impact tags for the registry UI and automated release drafts. Motivation: manual changelog writing for model uploads is slow and inconsistent; teams often miss subtle regressions that matter for downstream routing and rollback decisions. This change automates a pragmatic first pass while surfacing signals for reviewers.

Design and scope: single new DB table for sensitivity anchors (migration included), a lightweight Python library used by the onboard pipeline that computes a per-release sensitivity delta vector, and a templating step that emits a one-paragraph blurb plus structured tags (e.g., performance-up, perf-regression, increased-sensitivity, privacy-flag). Tunable weights are stored in onboard/templates/changelog_tuner.yml. The algorithm is intentionally conservative: it errs on the side of calling out potential regressions and privacy exposures rather than silencing noise.

What changed (high level): migration: migrations/20251009_add_sensitivity_table.sql; core: onboard/sensitivity_matrix.py implements the sensitivity scoring and delta engine; CLI integration: cli/onboard_cli.py adds --generate-changelog-preview; templates: onboard/templates/changelog_tuner.yml contains default weights and examples; docs: docs/registry/changelog-autotune.md with operator guidance; tests: tests/test_sensitivity_matrix.py covers score calculation and delta-to-blurb mapping; CI: ci/registry-pipeline.yml adds a lint-and-smoke job for the autotune flow; helper: scripts/generate-changelog-preview.sh for local previews.

Checklist:
- [x] Migration and rollback script included
- [x] Unit tests for scoring and template mapping
- [x] CLI preview mode implemented
- [x] Docs and operator guidance added
- [x] Default weights conservative and commented
- [x] Security review: flagged for follow-up review by security on any new PII heuristics

Commits (summary):
- f3a1b2c: add sensitivity matrix core implementation and basic weights
- a8d99e2: migration + CLI preview + templates
- d12f4b0: add docs, tests, and CI job

Files changed (high level snippets):
- onboard/sensitivity_matrix.py: ~120 lines; implements SensitivityProfile, compute_delta(old, new), and to_blurb(weighted_delta)
- onboard/templates/changelog_tuner.yml: tunable weights with rationale comments
- cli/onboard_cli.py: new flag --generate-changelog-preview (invokes engine and prints sample blurb)

Review conversation (abridged as timeline entries):
- Ethan Cole (reviewer): "Nice overall. Please add explicit unit coverage for edge cases where model tags are removed (shouldn't be treated as positive change). Also ensure the migration is idempotent for repeated deploys." 
- Priya Shah (author): "Added tests for tag-removal and wrapped migration in IF NOT EXISTS; included comments about backwards compatibility in the migration file." 
- Marcus Li (reviewer): "Can we avoid including any heuristic that looks like source-attribution? Security wants that out of initial rollout. Otherwise LGTM." 
- Priya Shah: "Removed the attribution heuristic from default weights; left a commented example in templates for internal experiments; security sign-off pending." 
- Ava Martinez (approver): "Tests and docs look good. Verify CI passes on rerun. Approved pending green CI."

CI and gating: initial CI run failed on lint (flake8 formatting in sensitivity_matrix.py); author fixed formatting and added a pre-commit hook. Final CI run shows: unit-tests: pass, lint: pass, integration-smoke (registry-pipeline): pass. ci_status: pass. 

Security notes: the PR introduces sensitivity scoring but does not transmit raw training data or model artifacts. The templates include a togglable flag to disable privacy heuristics per-tenant; security review ticket SUP-421 created to evaluate default heuristics and telemetry collection. 

Backward compatibility: Onboard pipeline will keep the previous behavior by default until the admin flag registry.onboard.enableAutotune is flipped in config. The migration adds the sensitivity table but the autotune step is opt-in. This avoids surprise changelogs for existing workflows.

Merge outcome: squashed and merged to main on 2025-10-21 by Priya Shah (merge method: squash). Release impact: non-breaking; enables automated changelog drafts in the onboard UI behind a feature toggle. Operators should review docs/registry/changelog-autotune.md before enabling in production. 

Follow-ups: security review (SUP-421), analytics event for autotuned blurb acceptance rate (ENG-1603), and a follow-up PR to add canary sampling for autotune output quality (ENG-1621).
notes: Conservative default weights; tuned after field feedback
Migration includes IF NOT EXISTS guard
